menu.title: TITLE
info.controls.title: CONTROLS
info.controls.body: MOVE ARROWS/WASD  FIRE Z  FOCUS CTRL  BOMB X  BREAK C. Hold FIRE to lock up to 8 targets; tap BREAK again while active for DOUBLE BREAK.
info.scoring.title: EMBER BLOOM SCORING
info.scoring.body: Destroy enemies, graze, and collect ember shards to fill two BREAK segments. BREAK raises firepower and score and lets shots erase soft bullets. DOUBLE BREAK spends another segment for maximum power. Multi-locks award a larger lock bonus. Bombing or dying ends BREAK.
info.credits.title: CREDITS
info.credits.body: Original game design and content pack created for goat-shooooting. Inspired by the lock-on and temporary-power-mode vocabulary of arcade bullet hell games; no third-party names, code, art, stages, or audio are included.
info.licenses.title: LICENSES & PRIVACY
info.licenses.body: See THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt, ASSET-LICENSES.txt, and PRIVACY.txt. This content pack uses primitive rendering and sends no telemetry.
